hbs.title: State-wise Total Installed Capacity of Grid Interactive Renewable Power

meta.coverage: State-wise Total Installed Capacity of Grid Interactive Renewable Power: RBI Handbook of Statistics on Indian States, Table 143
meta.note: DBIE report 1686, data provider "Main". Values exactly as DBIE serves them; each series carries its unit (scripts/lib/products/states.mjs HBS_UNITS, read from the table's unit column and divisor). Periods: fiscal years, dated at April. Dimensions: none; measures: value. Andhra Pradesh before 2014-15 is the undivided state, a separate series (Telangana was formed on 2 June 2014; 2014-15 straddles the split). Jammu & Kashmir to 2018-19 (with Ladakh) and from 2019-20 (the UT) are separate series; 2019-20 straddles the change of 31 October 2019.
